name: Glamer Gifter — "Choose up to one other target creature." is not a modal header
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py. 'Choose up to …' was taken for a modal spell header (pawprint 'Choose up to five {P} worth of modes'), so everything after it was treated as modes and dropped. A header that goes on to name targets is now ordinary text. Also: 'has base power and toughness 4/4 and gains all creature types' now emits both halves. The chosen Hill Giant is a 4/4 with every creature type; the Bears are untouched and no static effect leaks onto the Gifter.

call: choose up to one other target creature. Until end of turn, that creature has base power and toughness 4/4 and gains all creature types.
When this creature enters, choose up to one other target creature. Until end of turn, that creature has base power and toughness 4/4 and gains all creature types.
